evidence.quote: rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Mandating a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and to maintaining capability (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Equating unrehearsed rollback with non-possession frames capability as only real when proven through practice.
Restating the cadence as a fixed label appeals to stability and routine as the governing good.
Naming a single accountable owner appeals to standing and responsibility as the organizing good.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the text equating possession of a capability with proven practice of it, rather than asserting the capability abstractly?
